signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,lambda *_:sys.exit(0))

nextlog=0

 t=time.process_time()
 while time.process_time()-t<(0.005 if large else 0.02):pass
 time.sleep(0.18)
 if time.time()>=nextlog:
  nextlog=time.time()+20

   try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base+suffix,timeout=3) as r:record[suffix]=json.load(r)
   except Exception as e:record[suffix]={'error':str(e)}
  print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
